newsitem.title: USA: Gregg Appliances to buy Sun Television.
newsitem.headline: Gregg Appliances to buy Sun Television.

text.p: Sun Television and Appliances Inc said on Wednesday it would be acquired through a cash merger by Indiana-based appliance and electronic retailer Gregg Appliances Inc.
Under terms of the letter of intent, Sun Television said its shareholders would receive $5 per common share in cash.

Sun Television said its shareholders would also be eligible to receive net proceeds from expected tax refunds for income taxes Sun paid between fiscal years 1994 and 1996. The refunds would be worth an estimated $0.90 to $1.25 per Sun Television share, the company said.
The deal, which was subject to certain conditions, was expected to be completed before February 28, the company said.
Jerry Throgmartin, president of Gregg, said: "This combination will enable Gregg to expand into new markets in states contiguous to those in which Gregg currently operates."

Sun Television also said in a separate action, its board of directors authorized refinancing the company's unsecured $30 million senior notes and $50 million revolving bank debt. The company said it received a commitment letter from the CIT Group/Business Credit Inc for $100 million of three year secured revolving bank debt.
Sun Television said it expected completion and funding to take place by year-end 1996.
